overview: Set in 1951, a blacklisted Hollywood writer gets into a car accident, loses his memory and settles down in a small town where he is mistaken for a long-lost son.
tagline: Sometimes your life comes into focus one frame at a time.

recs.blurb: A small town girl and a city boy meet on the Sunset Strip, while pursuing their Hollywood dreams.
A magazine writer poses as a Jew to expose anti-Semitism.

A single mother, with dreams of becoming a writer, has a son at the age of 15 in 1965, and goes through a failed marriage with the drug-addicted father.
A car accident and shifting affections test the bond between a married couple.
Author P.L. Travers travels from London to Hollywood as Walt Disney Pictures adapts her novel Mary Poppins for the big screen.
In the small town of Mumford, a psychologist of the same name moves in and quickly becomes very popular, despite a questionable past.
A divorced writer from the Midwest returns to her hometown to reconnect with an old flame, who's now married with a family.
A British writer struggles to fit in at a high-profile magazine in New York. Based on Toby Young's memoir "How to Lose Friends & Alienate People".
A kid from the Midwest moves out to Hollywood in order to follow in his parents footsteps -- and become a porn star.
